title: Disable Auto Backup / Device Transfer — history privacy fix
depends_on: Sprint 4D.1 (baseline audit — informational, no code dependency)
blocks_resolved: Cross-device history restore via Android Auto Backup (Google Drive)
History carry-over via direct device-to-device transfer (Android 12+ Copy apps & data)
Privacy violation: history visible on second device with same Google account
strategy: Option A — clean break (no existing-data wipe logic; passive backup expiry)
architectural_notes: No DataStore code changes — runtime behavior of HistoryStorage and UserPreferencesRepository is unchanged
Existing on-device history NOT wiped — users with current installs keep their data
Existing Google Drive backups (if any) become unreadable on next install — passive expiry within 60 days of inactivity
